Description

Demonstrate both the first Thai space-based Internet-of-Things (IoT) communications systems and aviation monitoring system of Thailand.

The satellite will establish a smart city framework in the nation, leveraging information and communication technology to improve the utilization of urban resources. Simultaneously, the aviation monitoring system will aid in managing both manned and unmanned air traffic within Thailand.
